title: Bug: Update testbed setup documentation
author: opcoder0
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Description of the bug

The testbed setup documentation here https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/docs/testbed/README.testbed.Setup.md refers to Ubuntu 20.04 (which is EOL-ed). Update the documentation with up-to-date instructions.

### Steps to Reproduce

Updated documentation with the latest supported OS release

linkedPullRequests.body:
Summary:
Updates docs/testbed/README.testbed.Setup.md to remove the outdated Ubuntu 20.04 reference and align the testbed setup instructions with the currently documented Ubuntu 22.04 / Ubuntu 24.04 guidance.

Issue:
Fixes #25292

Testing:

* Documentation-only change.
* Verified the outdated "Ubuntu 20.04" reference was removed.
* Verified the setup doc now references Ubuntu 22.04 or Ubuntu 24.04.
